dict.string: Zenith Commander needs access to your Desktop folder to manage files.
Zenith Commander needs access to your Documents folder to manage files.
Zenith Commander needs access to your Downloads folder to manage files.
Zenith Commander needs Full Disk Access to provide the best file management experience across your entire system.
Zenith Commander needs access to external drives to manage files on removable media.
Zenith Commander needs access to network drives to manage files on remote servers.
